posts.cooked:
Apologies if others have said this. There's so much new content on the boards I haven't been able to get through it. Sentinel Tactics was released to playtesters yesterday. There are over 20 new threads in the playtest forums. I don't think we've seen this level of engagement before. The ranks of playtesters has swelled and there's a lot of excitement about the new game.

 

I really don't mean this as a tease to those not in the playtest forums. I thought you'd at least be interested that playtesting has started, particularly as it may lead to less traffic in the other forums.
